P_calibration.quote: Counsel should treat any reliance on this gap with great caution, since it is also an obvious fix for sponsors.

P_holdback.quote: Raising loopholes publicly before markup may prompt a further manager's amendment that closes them. Counsel may want to separate points [X] raise as unworkability or drafting problems (#5–7, #11, #23–26, #29–35) from points [X] hold in reserve.

P_grandfather_step.quote: Licenses issued in that window aren't grandfathered even though the prohibition isn't yet in force, which creates a gap and perhaps a rush-to-license incentive.

P_reliance_caveat.quote: Several items (#1, #8, #18) describe ambiguity, not safe harbors. I'd avoid treating any of them as a basis for operating decisions without counsel's analysis.
